findings.finding: Unexpected main-frame origins are silently omitted from navigation evidence, and the fixture password/code are entered without pinning the current origin at each authentication step.
findings.evidence: The navigation callback appends only when netloc is one of alisa.octoport.ru/id.octoport.ru and has no failure path for other origins. authenticate() fills password and code fields without checking the current URL origin after each transition.
findings.risk: An unexpected redirect could be hidden from the receipt; the script must not enter the existing fixture password into an unapproved page.
findings.minimal_fix: Fail closed on every out-of-scope main-frame navigation and verify the exact approved app/Identity origin immediately before each password or code entry; alternatively block all other navigation origins in the browser context.

reviewed_safe_boundaries: Uses a fresh browser context rather than restoring prior session state.
Clears only the product session cookie during the reentry scenario and checks native Identity session continuity.
Uses delivered mailbox code, checks an invalid code cannot open the cabinet, and compares same customer/tenant after valid reentry.
Stores browser state under a private tmpfs path and does not print credentials or cookies.
review_limits: Static review only; script was not executed and the fixture file was not read.
No host calls, production DB access, or account mutation performed.
